title: Lower bound for the integral of N over the square (1 − r, 1 + r) × (−r, r)
statement: Let N : ℝ × ℝ → [0, ∞], m ∈ ℕ and r > 0, and let Sq := (1 − r, 1 + r) × (−r, r) ⊆ ℝ × ℝ, with Lebesgue measure on ℝ × ℝ. Assume that m ≤ N(p) for almost every p ∈ Sq, and that m + 1 ≤ N(p) for almost every p ∈ Sq with p₂ > 0. Then ofReal((4m + 2)·r²) ≤ ∫⁻_{Sq} N(p) dp.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (m : ℕ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioo (1 - r) (1 + r) ×ˢ Ioo (-r) r → (m : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ N p) → (∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioo (1 - r) (1 + r) ×ˢ Ioo (-r) r → 0 < p.2 → (m : ℝ≥0∞) + 1 ≤ N p) → ENNReal.ofReal ((4 * (m : ℝ) + 2) * r ^ 2) ≤ ∫⁻ p in Ioo (1 - r) (1 + r) ×ˢ Ioo (-r) r, N p
